important_counter_semantics: smooth_*_debt_reduction and *_moves are local optimizer diagnostics; they are not proof of globally published bad-cell retirement. Compare against complete census and published quality_progress.
quality_progress is the engine counter; DETAIL per-rank values are rank-local contributions, so sums below are explicitly rank-summed.
batch_candidates counts locally coalesced choices; batch_reserved counts reservation winners. Their rank-summed ratio is descriptive, not a global scheduler utilization or proof of wasted work.
smooth_*_rejects order is validity, shape, metric-edge, geometry, as emitted by the stage reporter.

complete_census.strict_gate_result: Both complete exit censuses are rejected by the strict checker because q/J bad cells remain; geometry_bad also remains nonzero, but that counter can be an unresolved conservative upper bound and is not proof that every counted cell is a geometry violation. Size_bad is zero. No accepted adapted mesh is established.

timing.interpretation: Matched same configured time budget and close phase durations; the observed elapsed difference is small and run ownership/host conditions differ, so this is not isolated evidence of a throughput change.

complete_census.metric_complexity_target_basis: A206 run.cfg ADAP_COMPLEXITY=50000; actual native exit cell counts are reported independently.

candidate_reservation.interpretation: A206 has about 18% fewer local choices becoming reserved winners; this alone does not identify underfilled slots because conflicts, refused slots and repair-slot allocation affect the count. No rank saturation/capacity proof is available from this ratio.

reconstruction_and_coordination.interpretation: The construction/improvement continuation path was exercised (3 quality stages, 2 construction returns), so construction is not an unexercised branch in this run. Aggregate improvement/reopening is visible in complete phase censuses; it does not prove repeated identical local cavities.

quality_repair_and_gate_misses.private_gain_warning: Optimizer debt-reduction sums are not comparable to census debt without matching exact fields and published updates; they cannot be credited as accepted global gain.
quality_repair_and_gate_misses.geometry_bad_interpretation: The terminal geometry_bad census is a conservative unresolved upper bound where applicable, not a demonstrated count of all proven geometry violations.
quality_repair_and_gate_misses.EXIT_location_split: Now available and recorded in seven_group_diagnostics for both attempts; earlier-window location data was not substituted.

geometry_query_and_cache_work.interpretation: Traversal, upper queries and scope preparation remain large measured work. Detail timing has a large unattributed other bucket, and these nested per-rank timers overlap; no single geometry-query bottleneck or pure idle/join fraction can be inferred.

short_edge_association.A206: First EXIT LOCATION shows the count of q-or-J-bad cells with an edge shorter than .9 and .5 on the same census; per-rank and aggregate counts are retained. Association is not causality.
short_edge_association.B202: First EXIT LOCATION likewise includes short-edge association; see per-rank and aggregate raw groups.

target_and_actual_cells.interpretation: Actual cells are reported separately from metric complexity. The selected native counters do not include a complete comparable realized metric-complexity total; no target drift conclusion is made.

rank_cpu_and_collective_accounting.interpretation: CPU/engine ratios near one indicate substantial process CPU use; collective/election timers are accounting for time spent in communication/control paths and must not be called pure idle time. Timers overlap/nest, so do not add these shares.

blocked_or_deferred_queue.source: First EXIT QUALITY plus existing first-event DETAIL rows, preserved per rank in seven_group_diagnostics.
blocked_or_deferred_queue.interpretation: Queue, blocked feature, stuck shape/required, missing feature, and remaining-work values are now reported at EXIT. They do not establish permanently blocked queue entries; counters are snapshots.

limits: No event-2 rows included; A raw logs contain 58 bytes after preserved event-1 prefix on each rank, excluded by prefix hash.
No exact-repeated-cavity or near-position classification: the A rejected mesh was not dumped.
Rank-local DETAIL times include nested/overlapping accounting and should not be added as independent wall-time costs.
The A and B attempts are not controlled repeats; ownership and host conditions differed.
Exact repeated-cavity / near-position trial classification remains unavailable; this is distinct from the present EXIT service, location, short-edge, ladder, queue, and target-drift census groups.
The reported quality-phase elapsed is engine time since first quality entry, including intervening construction returns and ownership transitions; it is not an isolated sum of quality-only timers.
assessment: A206 is blocked by strict whole-field repair/closure under the fixed time budget. Construction ran, with 3 quality stages and 2 construction returns. Across all repair phases, published ladder gains total 54,764 q and 54,278 J bad cells removed; between-phase construction transitions reintroduced 964 q and 1,227 J bad cells, reconciling exactly to the entry-to-exit net reductions of 53,800 q and 53,051 J. The terminal EXIT interval alone is much smaller and is labeled separately. Strict acceptance still fails with 281 q-bad and 341 J-bad cells. Geometry_bad 2,129 may include conservative unresolved upper bounds. EXIT location shows 139/142 q and 220/121 J surface/interior; all 466 cells in the q-or-J union are associated with an edge under 0.5, a correlation only. Cumulative published ladder commits exactly match the 53,290 EXIT QUALITY commits_total; private DETAIL optimizer counts remain separate. Engine/quality-phase durations are close to baseline202, with ownership/host differences preventing isolated throughput attribution. Continue with repair power plus shape/geometry reclosure; treat speed as a measured secondary path, and do not change scheduler decisions from these counters.

semantic_notes: QUALITY_LADDER commits are published commits; certified is prepublication certification; trials/work/debt are ladder attempts. Source increments published only when approved proposals are committed in the publication path.
NATIVE3D_DETAIL optimization counters describe private optimizer operations. They are not interchangeable with published ladder commits or whole-field census changes.

LOCATION q/j histograms are bins emitted by miss_bin: sqrt(debt) <.01, <.1, <.25, <.5, >=.5, nonfinite. Geometry histogram bins reflect relative excess thresholds from source. Geometry type indices 0-4 are analytic kind enum values, 5 affine, 6 curved-reference, 7 no captured type; categories can overlap.
short05/short09 count the union of q-or-J-bad cells with at least one metric edge below the threshold; these establish same-census association, not causality.
DRIFT samples=16, supported/lost and Frobenius drift are target-metric sample diagnostics, not realized global metric complexity.

Per-rank `global_work`, work_limit and progress-window DETAIL fields are replicated global counters; they are reported as common values, never summed across ranks. Service/quality rows are explicitly described as rank sums when aggregated.

Per-rank LADDER rows attached to terminal EXIT groups are EXIT-interval deltas only. Full-event yields are separately summed across every census from first quality_entry through EXIT; cumulative published commits reconcile exactly to rank-summed EXIT QUALITY commits_total (A 53,290; B 52,536).
